state.sql:
```sql
SELECT
    YEAR([TRANSDATE]) AS ClaimYear,
    [REPAIRTYPE],
    COUNT(*) AS ClaimCount
FROM
    [dbo].[ECS_CLAIMTABLE]
WHERE
    [TRANSDATE] >= DATEADD(year, -3, GETDATE())
GROUP BY
    YEAR([TRANSDATE]),
    [REPAIRTYPE]
ORDER BY
    ClaimYear,
    [REPAIRTYPE];
```
